newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ monetary conditions index up in March - BTNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ monetary conditions index up in March - BTNZ.

text.p: Bankers Trust New Zealand said on Wednesday its monetary conditions index rose slightly to average 129 in March from 127 in January.
The assumed MCI for the June 1997 quarter based on the Reserve Bank's March economic projects is 124.
Bankers Trust said the market was not entirely convinced by the RBNZ's view of inflation.
The overall mix of monetary conditions remains about 50 basis points tighter in interest rate terms than that assumed by the RBNZ.
BT said it held its view that strong New Zealand growth would see a sharp tightening in monetary conditions over the second half of 1997.
